panels.title: Observed tactics (ATT&CK)
panels.description: Each event_type is mapped to its primary ATT&CK tactic. Same mapping logic as intel/mitre.py — replicated in SQL for live querying.

targets.queryText: SELECT tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN event_type LIKE 'ssh_login%' OR event_type LIKE 'ftp_login%' OR event_type LIKE 'rdp_%' OR event_type LIKE 'http_credential%' THEN 'Initial Access (TA0001)' WHEN event_type LIKE 'ssh_command%' OR event_type LIKE 'shell_%' THEN 'Execution (TA0002)' WHEN event_type LIKE 'ssh_session%' THEN 'Persistence (TA0003)' WHEN event_type LIKE '%scan%' OR event_type LIKE 'http_active_recon' OR event_type LIKE 'dns_query%' THEN 'Discovery (TA0007)' WHEN event_type LIKE '%credential%' OR event_type LIKE 'honeytoken_triggered_credential%' THEN 'Credential Access (TA0006)' WHEN event_type LIKE 'ssh_port_forward' OR event_type LIKE 'http_canary%' OR event_type LIKE '%callback%' THEN 'Command and Control (TA0011)' WHEN event_type LIKE 'ssh_file_download' OR event_type LIKE '%exfil%' THEN 'Exfiltration (TA0010)' ELSE 'Uncategorised' END AS tactic FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')) GROUP BY tactic ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Top event types (raw)
panels.description: Unmapped event types — useful for finding new attack patterns to extend the MITRE mapping with.

targets.queryText: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips, SUM(CASE WHEN severity='critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', timestamp) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type LIKE 'ssh_login%' OR event_type LIKE 'ftp_login%' OR event_type LIKE 'rdp_%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS initial_access, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type LIKE 'ssh_command%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS execution, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type LIKE '%scan%' OR event_type LIKE 'http_active_recon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discovery, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type LIKE '%credential%' OR event_type LIKE 'honeytoken_triggered%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS credential_access, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type LIKE 'ssh_port_forward' OR event_type LIKE '%canary%' OR event_type LIKE '%callback%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2 FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H', timestamp) ORDER BY time
